title: Skateboard with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Skateboard deck -->
  <rect x="10" y="45" width="80" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FF6B35"/>
  <!-- Deck top highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="47" width="72" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFB627"/>
  <!-- Nose kick -->
  <path d="M10 52 Q6 45 12 40 Q18 36 20 42" fill="#FF6B35" stroke="#FFB627" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Tail kick -->
  <path d="M90 52 Q94 45 88 40 Q82 36 80 42" fill="#FF6B35" stroke="#FFB627" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Trucks -->
  <rect x="25" y="59" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#4ECDC4"/>
  <rect x="65" y="59" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#4ECDC4"/>
  
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="68" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="68" r="3" fill="#FFB627"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="68" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="68" r="3" fill="#FFB627"/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on deck -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="3" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="51" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="51" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M38 56 Q50 66 62 56" fill="none" stroke="#1A1A2E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="57" r="2.5" fill="#FF9F9B" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="57" r="2.5" fill="#FF9F9B" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
